title: QRAE: Query-Relevant Attention Entropy for Context Compression in DeepSearch Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.07976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: DeepSearch LLM agents repeatedly search and carry retrieved sources into subsequent reasoning steps. This expanding context increases token consumption and latency, although many results do not contribute to later reasoning. We propose Query-Relevant Attention Entropy (QRAE), an online context compression method that uses sparse evidence-assessment heads to decide which intact retrieved chunks should persist across reasoning steps. It scores bounded candidate batches through paired prefills: a query-free control suppresses shared attention responses, while normalized entropy measures the breadth of the positive response within each chunk. High-scoring chunks enter a persistent evidence whitelist and are included in the reasoning context. Uncertain chunks remain outside the reasoning context but are retained in a candidate cache, where they can be retrieved for later reevaluation. QRAE requires neither an additional generative compression

translated_title: QRAE：用于DeepSearch智能体上下文压缩的查询相关注意力熵
translated_abstract: DeepSearch LLM智能体会反复进行搜索，并将检索到的资料带入后续的推理步骤中。这种不断扩大的上下文会增加token消耗和延迟，尽管其中许多结果对后续推理并无贡献。我们提出查询相关注意力熵，这是一种在线上下文压缩方法，它利用稀疏的证据评估头来决定哪些完整的检索文本块应在推理步骤中持续保留。该方法通过成对的预填充对有界的候选批次进行评分：无查询的对照组用于抑制共享的注意力响应，而归一化熵则衡量每个文本块内正向响应的广度。高分的文本块会进入持久的证据白名单，并被纳入推理上下文。不确定的文本块则保留在推理上下文之外，但会被存入候选缓存中，以便后续可被重新检索并重新评估。QRAE既不需要额外的生成式压缩（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出QRAE方法，通过查询相关注意力熵对DeepSearch智能体检索到的文本块进行在线评分与筛选，将高价值证据保留在推理上下文中并缓存不确定内容，从而在多步搜索推理中有效压缩上下文、降低token消耗与延迟。
en_tdlr: QRAE uses query-relevant attention entropy to online-score retrieved chunks in DeepSearch agents, persisting high-value evidence in the reasoning context while caching uncertain ones, thereby compressing context and reducing token consumption and latency across multi-step search reasoning.
